Rahul Gandhi's March Features Student Leader Jannat Bishnoi

During a march led by Congress leader Rahul Gandhi towards the Supreme Court, a young student leader named Jannat Bishnoi was frequently seen alongside him and Priyanka Gandhi in a vehicle. Bishnoi, described as a Gen-Z youth leader, has emerged from student politics to national prominence, sparking discussions and speculation.
